description: Test class for ProtocolFactory, verifying topic path creation and validation methods.

classes.name: ProtocolFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test suite for the ProtocolFactory class, testing topic path building from various entity identifiers and validating input handling.

methods.name: testInvalidPolicyModifyTopicPathWithChannel
methods.description: Ensures that providing a specific invalid topic path throws an UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: testInvalidGroup
methods.description: Checks that an invalid group in the topic path throws an UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: testInvalidCriterion
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid criterion causes the method to throw an UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: testInvalidChannel
methods.description: Validates that an invalid channel parameter results in an UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: testInvalidAction
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid action throws an UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: testMissingGroup
methods.description: Tests that a missing group segment results in an exception.

methods.name: testMissingId
methods.description: Verifies that a missing ID segment triggers an exception.

methods.name: testMissingNamespace
methods.description: Checks that an empty namespace segment leads to an exception.

methods.name: testNullPath
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to newTopicPath results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromThingId
methods.description: Verifies correct topic path creation from a ThingId object.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromNamespacedEntityId
methods.description: Verifies path creation when starting from a DefaultNamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromPolicyId
methods.description: Tests topic path creation from a PolicyId and validates path segments.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromNamespace
methods.description: Tests creating a topic path builder from a namespace and validates built path segments.
